description: Prepare or execute a server-bound plan to create a serverless inference endpoint for a model. Use when the user wants per-token inference with no idle cost, rather than renting a dedicated GPU — prefer this over create_instance for bursty or low-volume inference. confirm:false returns a preview and creates nothing; execution goes through the same plan approval as a GPU launch. Once created, the endpoint bills per million tokens processed and costs nothing while idle.

model_ref.description: HuggingFace model id or image ref

name: create_serverless_endpoint
